skill.name: code-review
skill.description: Guides pull request preparation, review requests, feedback handling, and final approval checks for code review workflows.
skill.summary: Structured workflow for pull request review preparation and feedback response.
skill.author: Doyajin174

content.user_title: Review Pull Requests with Structured Feedback
content.value_statement: Code reviews often slow down when context, testing, and feedback responses are unclear. This skill provides checklists and response patterns for focused pull request reviews.
actual_capabilities: Provides a pre-review checklist for tests, linting, scope, and commit messages.
Supplies a pull request description template with what, why, how, testing, and screenshots sections.
Classifies common review feedback types and suggests appropriate response behavior.
Offers response patterns for accepted feedback, clarification, and disagreement.
Lists requester and reviewer practices for small changes and clear feedback.
limitations: Does not inspect source code unless the user provides repository context.
Does not run tests, linting, or build commands on its own.
Does not replace project-specific review policies or team conventions.
Does not provide language-specific static analysis rules.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Pull Request
use_cases.description: Create a clear review request with scope, rationale, testing notes, and screenshots when needed.

use_cases.title: Respond to Reviewer Feedback
use_cases.description: Handle bug reports, style comments, design questions, and disagreements with consistent communication.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Reviews
use_cases.description: Use shared checklists and feedback labels to make reviews easier to scan and resolve.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Review Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me prepare a pull request description. Ask for the change summary, reason, implementation details, testing, and screenshots.

prompt_templates.title: Check Review Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my planned pull request against the checklist. Identify missing tests, unclear scope, lint concerns, and weak commit messages.

prompt_templates.title: Respond to Feedback
prompt_templates.prompt: Classify these review comments as bug, style, design question, or disagreement. Draft concise responses for each item.

prompt_templates.title: Facilitate a Review Decision
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize unresolved review threads, separate must-fix items from suggestions, and propose a final approval path.

output_examples.input: I need a PR description for a small bug fix.
output_examples.output: A completed review request with change summary, reason, implementation notes, testing status, and screenshot guidance.

output_examples.input: A reviewer asked why I used the current design.
output_examples.output: A respectful response that explains the tradeoff, invites alternatives, and records whether a change is needed.

output_examples.input: Our team wants a consistent review checklist.
output_examples.output: A concise checklist covering test status, lint status, scope, feedback priority, and final approval readiness.

best_practices: Keep pull requests small and focused before asking for review.
Provide review context before asking others to inspect code.
Label feedback by priority so authors can act efficiently.
anti_patterns: Open broad pull requests without explaining the change scope.
Treat style preferences as mandatory without checking team conventions.
Reject reviewer questions without explaining the implementation tradeoff.

faq.question: Does this skill review code directly?
faq.answer: It guides the review workflow. Direct code review requires the user to provide code or repository context.

faq.question: Can it create a pull request description?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides a template for what changed, why it changed, how it works, testing, and screenshots.

faq.question: Does it run tests or lint commands?
faq.answer: No. It reminds users to verify tests and linting, but it does not execute those commands.

faq.question: Can it help with difficult reviewer feedback?
faq.answer: Yes. It suggests response patterns for accepted feedback, needed explanations, and respectful disagreement.

faq.question: Is it useful for reviewers?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes reviewer practices such as constructive comments, priority labels, and balanced feedback.
